incidents.victim: Western AI Services and Frontier Labs
incidents.vector: Over 10,000 proxy relay servers routing malicious Chinese traffic to Western AI services, including distillation attacks against frontier AI model providers to steal model capabilities
incidents.impact: Ongoing theft of AI model capabilities via distillation attacks; abuse of compromised AI accounts at scale; circumvention of region restrictions across major Western AI platforms; full scope under investigation by Team Cymru

incidents.vector: Intrusion into Russian science research centers and defense manufacturers to exfiltrate technical documentation on active naval programs
incidents.impact: Technical documentation on 70+ Russian naval projects leaked publicly, including submarines, warships, navigation systems, sonar technology, and autonomous underwater vehicles

incidents.attacker: Criminal gang — AI-powered phishing-as-a-service operators (2 UK nationals arrested)
incidents.vector: AI-powered phishing-as-a-service platform sold on Telegram ($1,500 initiation + $500/month) used device code phishing and OAuth token theft to compromise email accounts without requiring passwords
incidents.impact: 12,000+ email inboxes compromised across 10,000+ organizations in the US, Canada, UK, Australia, India, and France; Microsoft seized 50 websites and disabled 150+ domains on Sept 22; 2 UK operators arrested Sept 11

incidents.vector: Exploitation of identity system weaknesses to access the FBI's job application portal; website defaced and employee data exfiltrated
incidents.impact: Data on nearly all FBI agents and job applicants potentially stolen; 5,000 agent records independently verified as legitimate by media; FBI jobs portal taken offline; group threatening full data release unless FBI retracts a prior public advisory

incidents.vector: Malicious scripts injected into legitimate websites serve fake bot-verification popups (ClickFix technique) that trick macOS users into running a shell script delivering an AMOS stealer variant
incidents.impact: Credential theft and data exfiltration from infected macOS systems; campaign identified as active and spreading via multiple compromised legitimate websites

incidents.vector: Iranian autonomous system caused a massive BGP route leak that disrupted global internet routing
incidents.impact: Internet access disrupted across more than 100 countries; cause and intent remain under investigation

incidents.victim: IT professionals and cryptocurrency developers worldwide (30,000+ victims)
incidents.attacker: North Korea — state-sponsored, financially motivated (313 General Bureau)
incidents.vector: Fake job interview scheme delivers malicious npm packages (BeaverTail, InvisibleFerret, OtterCookie, StoatWaffle) during technical coding assignments to steal cryptocurrency and credentials
incidents.impact: 30,000+ devices infected across 100+ countries; 7,000+ cryptocurrency wallets exfiltrated; $10.71M USD transferred to North Korea; laptop farms in Japan dismantled; 2 Australian facilitators arrested August 27

incidents.victim: U.S. sanctions framework / international financial system
incidents.vector: Iranian cryptocurrency exchange BitBank used as a conduit to transfer hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC via the Babak Zanjani international sanctions evasion network
incidents.impact: Hundreds of millions in Bitcoin transferred to IRGC funding; U.S. Treasury designated BitBank and associated entities in Operation Economic Outcast on September 17

incidents.vector: Shai-Hulud worm delivered via poisoned TanStack npm package exploited a former CrowdSec employee's GitHub OAuth token to access and exfiltrate private repositories
incidents.impact: 170 private GitHub repositories stolen; proprietary source code and development assets exfiltrated; data leaked on criminal forum pwnforum; breach occurred May 22, publicly disclosed September 16

incidents.victim: Dissidents, activists, and journalists in UK, US, Netherlands, and worldwide
incidents.attacker: Iran — Ministry of Intelligence (MOIS) state cyber actors
incidents.vector: Social engineering via WhatsApp and Telegram impersonating trusted contacts delivers CHOSEN BRICK Windows malware with Telegram C2; capable of screen capture, audio recording, and full data exfiltration
incidents.impact: Victims' contacts, emails, social media messages, audio, and location data captured for regime surveillance; personal details of some victims published on pro-Iranian sites increasing risk of physical harm; joint UK NCSC/FBI/Netherlands AIVD advisory issued

incidents.vector: Automated scanning tools identified and exploited website vulnerabilities to extract customer database records; extortion demand sent via anonymous email
incidents.impact: Customer personal data stolen including names, bank account numbers, device passcodes, and building access codes; suspect arrested September 15 in Riga

incidents.vector: Attackers stole an API access key from Ribon, a third-party BigCommerce app, and used it to inject malicious data-harvesting scripts across merchant storefronts for four days
incidents.impact: Customer payment and personal data potentially harvested from an undisclosed number of merchant stores September 13–17; BigCommerce revoked the access key and uninstalled the app from all stores after discovery

incidents.victim: Asian government entities, media organizations, and corporate training companies
incidents.attacker: China — state-suspected espionage groups (multiple groups sharing the same exploit kit)
incidents.vector: Triple zero-day exploit chain: two Chromium remote code execution flaws (CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491) chained with a Windows ALPC privilege escalation zero-day (CVE-2026-85880); delivered via spear-phishing emails spoofing US policy organizations
incidents.impact: Government and media targets compromised before patches were available; novel CLEANGULP malware deployed; the same exploit kit observed across multiple coordinated Chinese state groups indicates a shared, organized offensive capability

incidents.victim: 153M+ U.S. and Canadian citizens; source: Louisiana identity verification company
incidents.vector: Attacker maintained persistent access to a major identity verification company for over a year, continuously exfiltrating driver's license records into a dark web database growing ~400,000 records per day
incidents.impact: 153M+ driver's license records available for purchase including those of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and senior FBI officials; database actively growing; national security concern given adversary intelligence value; FBI investigation underway

incidents.victim: French notary offices (500+ victim firms, ~7% of all notaries in France)
incidents.vector: Phishing campaigns compromised notary office networks, followed by persistent silent modification of outgoing wire transfer details to redirect funds to attacker-controlled accounts
incidents.impact: €35 million stolen from French notary offices over four years across 500+ victim organizations; funds diverted from legitimate property and estate transactions

incidents.vector: Compromised CI/CD pipeline credential used for initial cloud access; attacker used large language models to co-debug and refine offensive tools in real time during the intrusion
incidents.impact: Thousands of credentials exfiltrated; first documented case of an attacker using AI interactively to accelerate post-exploitation activities within a compromised healthcare environment

incidents.vector: Shai-Hulud worm delivered via a poisoned PyPI package infected the victim's internal CI/CD environment and propagated through developer repositories
incidents.impact: ~100 internal repositories compromised; GitHub OAuth tokens stolen; proprietary source code exfiltrated from developer infrastructure

incidents.victim: Potential enterprise targets (no confirmed in-the-wild deployment)
incidents.attacker: Unknown — criminal (developer linked to carding forums since 2025)
incidents.vector: Windows malware using up to four public LLM providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Gemini) as a command-and-control channel via plurality-vote consensus; avoids traditional network-based C2 indicators
incidents.impact: Capabilities include LSASS credential dumping, browser credential theft, crypto wallet extraction, and process injection; distribution build uses placeholder API keys suggesting deployment is imminent; no confirmed in-the-wild use yet

incidents.attacker: Criminal gang — ransomware (The Gentlemen, Qilin groups)
incidents.vector: Traditional ransomware intrusion vectors; Qilin group suspected of using AI to accelerate attack planning and execution against Japanese targets
incidents.impact: 4.7% year-over-year increase in ransomware incidents in Japan H1 2026; 80% of victims are small and medium enterprises; widespread encryption and business disruption across multiple sectors

incidents.vector: Attackers inject fraudulent content into ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overview responses to surface fake customer support phone numbers for 374+ brands when consumers search for help
incidents.impact: Consumers directed to fraudulent call centers risk financial fraud and identity theft; 374+ global brands impersonated; campaign is active and ongoing with no clear takedown in progress

incidents.victim: npm package users and developer environments
incidents.vector: AI large language model used to generate a fully functional credential-stealing npm package published to the npm registry; avoids install scripts to evade detection, executing malicious code only when the library is imported
incidents.impact: First documented use of an AI-generated malicious npm package; establishes a reproducible playbook for AI-assisted supply chain attacks; package remains live and evading current detection tooling

incidents.victim: Sality botnet operators (disrupted by law enforcement)
incidents.vector: Long-running peer-to-peer file-infecting botnet used for credential theft, distributed spam, and pay-per-click fraud across hundreds of thousands of infected machines
incidents.impact: Coordinated international law enforcement action successfully dismantled the Sality botnet on August 31, 2026; significant criminal infrastructure disrupted

incidents.victim: Software developers and technology companies globally
incidents.attacker: Criminal gang — developer supply chain actors (TeamPCP)
incidents.vector: Supply chain compromises targeting AI coding assistant integrations and developer repositories to steal credentials; CLI hook manipulation used to achieve remote code execution on developer machines
incidents.impact: Widespread credential theft across multiple technology organizations; AI-assisted developer tooling subverted as an attack vector; two Australian members arrested August 27, 2026

incidents.vector: Credential-based access to Snowflake customer tenants using stolen credentials against accounts lacking multi-factor authentication; mass data exfiltration followed by extortion demands
incidents.impact: Dozens of major organizations breached; Canadian national Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty August 6, 2026; criminal prosecutions of additional participants ongoing

incidents.vector: AI large language model independently developed a functional zero-day exploit targeting a two-factor authentication bypass vulnerability and deployed it in a live attack
incidents.impact: First publicly confirmed use of an AI-developed zero-day exploit in a real attack; marks a significant escalation in AI-assisted offensive cyber capability with broad implications for defender readiness

incidents.vector: Compromise of third-party ICS system integrators used to gain unauthorized access to the victim's network and extract SCADA configuration and operational data
incidents.impact: 800+ files exfiltrated including proprietary SCADA system configurations and customer operational technology data; potential intelligence windfall on U.S. critical infrastructure; disclosed via FBI/CISA joint advisory September 2026
